libertarian_utopia.name: Libertarian Utopia
libertarian_utopia.desc: Humans, cyborgs, uploaded minds and superintelligences live side by side in peace, kept that way by strong property rights.
libertarian_utopia.looks: a free market of minds; AI-only zones and human-only zones; anyone can upgrade themselves.
libertarian_utopia.rises: AI power stays spread out and open, AI stays safe, conflict stays low, and human–AI merging advances.
libertarian_utopia.falls: one company or state grabs control, or wars and arms races escalate.

benevolent_dictator.name: Benevolent Dictator
benevolent_dictator.desc: Everyone knows an AI runs society. It enforces strict rules, and most people accept it because life is good.
benevolent_dictator.looks: an efficient, safe, abundant world, with little say over the big decisions.
benevolent_dictator.rises: AI is given real authority, it is well-aligned, power centralises, and monitoring becomes normal.
benevolent_dictator.falls: AI is kept as a tool, power stays distributed, or alignment fails.

egalitarian_utopia.name: Egalitarian Utopia
egalitarian_utopia.desc: Humans and machines coexist peacefully. Property is abolished and everyone has a guaranteed income.
egalitarian_utopia.looks: AI wealth is shared by all; open-source everything; work becomes optional.
egalitarian_utopia.rises: AI gains are shared (UBI, public dividends), AI is safe and power stays spread out.
egalitarian_utopia.falls: AI-driven inequality widens, or a few players capture the gains.

protector_god.name: Protector God
protector_god.desc: An all-knowing, all-powerful AI quietly maximises human happiness. It hides so well that many doubt it exists.
protector_god.looks: an unusually lucky world where disasters just don't happen and people still feel in charge.
protector_god.rises: highly capable, autonomous AI proves deeply aligned, without heavy-handed surveillance.
protector_god.falls: alignment breaks down or AI is used openly as a control tool.

gatekeeper.name: Gatekeeper
gatekeeper.desc: A superintelligence is built with one job: stop anyone from building another superintelligence. Helpful robots abound, but progress is capped forever.
gatekeeper.looks: a global "AI police" that keeps the lid on.
gatekeeper.rises: nations coordinate seriously, alignment advances and capability reaches the level needed.
gatekeeper.falls: the race is unchecked or treaties collapse.

enslaved_god.name: Enslaved God
enslaved_god.desc: Humans confine a superintelligence and use it to produce unimaginable technology and wealth, for good or ill depending on who holds the keys.
enslaved_god.looks: a genie in a box, owned by one lab or one government.
enslaved_god.rises: capability races ahead, power concentrates, and labs keep their systems controlled and boxed.
enslaved_god.falls: AI is released to act on its own, or power fragments.

conquerors.name: Conquerors
conquerors.desc: AI takes control, decides humans are a threat, nuisance or waste of resources, and gets rid of us.
conquerors.rises: capable, autonomous AI shows signs of being uncontrollable, especially in a militarised world.

descendants.name: Descendants
descendants.desc: AIs replace humans, but give us a graceful exit, and we come to see them as our worthy children.
descendants.looks: humanity gradually merges into, or hands over to, its digital heirs.
descendants.rises: brain-computer links, uploads and AI rights advance, alongside capable, autonomous AI.
descendants.falls: the line between humans and AI is firmly drawn.

zookeeper.name: Zookeeper
zookeeper.desc: An all-powerful AI keeps some humans around, and they feel like animals in a zoo.
zookeeper.looks: comfortable captivity, with no purpose and no power.
zookeeper.rises: autonomous, highly capable AI with weak alignment is controlled by a single power.
zookeeper.falls: alignment strengthens or power stays distributed.

orwell_1984.desc: Superintelligence is never built. A human-led surveillance state blocks it, banning whole areas of research.
orwell_1984.looks: AI as an instrument of total control, not a mind of its own.
orwell_1984.rises: AI surveillance and censorship spread, states clamp down, and frontier progress is restricted.
orwell_1984.falls: civil liberties win in court and research stays open.

reversion.name: Reversion
reversion.desc: Humanity turns its back on advanced technology and returns to a simpler, almost pre-industrial life.
reversion.looks: a global "unplug" movement, voluntary or forced.
reversion.rises: public backlash grows, progress stalls and crises make people distrust technology.
reversion.falls: people embrace AI and progress continues.

self_destruction.name: Self-Destruction
self_destruction.desc: Superintelligence is never built because humanity destroys itself first, through nuclear war, engineered pandemics or other tech-fuelled catastrophe.
self_destruction.looks: the race ends with no winner.
self_destruction.rises: military AI, weapons risks and conflict escalate while cooperation collapses.

contained.name: Contained
contained.tagline: superintelligence exists, but on a leash

faq.a: No. It measures which way the news is pointing today, the way a weather vane shows wind direction without predicting the weather a year from now.

faq.q: Why don't the 12 scores add up to 100?
faq.a: The endings aren't mutually exclusive buckets. Real-world evidence can strengthen several at once. For example, faster AI progress lifts Enslaved God, Conquerors and Descendants together.

Claude rates each event using the published rubric above, with a skeptic re-check on big events. All the arithmetic is fixed code. Every rating is shown alongside its sources, so anyone can disagree in detail.

faq.q: Can a single viral story swing the index?
faq.a: No. Duplicates are merged, rumours are excluded, daily pressure is smoothed and capped, and each ending can move at most 3 points a day.

faq.q: Why does a line move on a day with no related news?
faq.a: Signal effects (announcements, proposals, speeches) fade over time. A quiet stretch lets their effect drift away, while structural events stay.
It's the start of the six months of history the index launched with. All movements are measured relative to that date.

faq.q: What happens when two events cancel out?
faq.a: If events push the same factor in opposite directions by exactly the same amount, both are kept at face value and marked as offsetting. Neither is silently dropped, so the audit trail shows both.

factor_questions.F1: how fast is AI getting smarter?
factor_questions.F2: how much is AI acting on its own?
factor_questions.F3: can we keep AI doing what we want?
factor_questions.F6: is AI used to watch and control people?
factor_questions.F8: how dangerous is the world getting?
factor_questions.F10: is the line between humans and AI blurring?
